We need to do something quick if we got any chance of surviving this!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 35 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Honor Guard''' is a mini boss that appears only in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It also appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health, the highest for a non-boss enemy in the entire mode, only being beaten by the [[Fallen King]] and its [[Hidden Wave]] version, [[Awakened Fallen King]]. While it does have a high amount of health, it is slow. It has two abilities, first being ''For Honor'', where it smashes its flails to the ground, creating a shockwave that stuns any tower and damages any unit caught in it. The second ability is ''Guard's Grace,'' which makes it leave a puddle of goo every 0.5 seconds which lasts for 6 minutes. This trail of goo applies a 10% speed buff to any enemy that walks over it for 1 second. Puddles from multiple '''Fallen Honor Guards''' can stack their effects. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Honor Guards were the elite of the elite, chosen personally by the King to protect the kingdom's most sacred sites. They were there when the King failed to find new magic, and they stood guard as the Queen met her end. They are the Fallen King's most prized guards who had fallen, just as he did.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Honor Guard''' is a hulking humanoid. It has black skin with multiple blue veins. It also has a few bandages around its arms. It has very dark teal and silver armor with cyan gems plating its whole body and a frog-mouth helm with cyan gems covering its whole head, and two large, spiked flails connected to its arms, which it smashes into the ground when using its ''For Honor'' ability. The gem on its chest plate emits blue light. All of its armor is covered in small amounts of dirt. When it walks, it leaves behind a purple trail, makes loud footsteps and shakes the screen. ==Strategy== *Deal with this enemy as soon as possible. Leaving it alive for too long will allow its ''Guard's Grace'' ability to leave a vast amount of goo, with a whopping 6 minute lifespan, on the path behind itself. This can give enemies that spawn behind it a huge advantage, allowing them to progress further. **In addition, the goo will most likely last towards the final wave, allowing the [[Fallen King]] to take advantage of the 10% speed buff. ***High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] should be used to defeat it quickly. ***The [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to boost these towers. **Furthermore, one should expect to fight the next wave with the '''Fallen Honor Guard''' still alive, as its debut wave lasts an extremely short amount of time. ***To deal with the waves that arrive alongside it, splash damage or multi-target towers are highly recommended. The [[Tesla]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are all excellent options, though it may be best to put [[Rocketeer]]/[[Mortar]] on ''Strongest'' or ''Random'' targeting to allow them to utilize their explosion radius more consistently. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers, preventing them from being stunned by the '''Fallen Honor Guard's''' ''For Honor'' ability. **Alternatively, you can place cheap towers along the path to divert the ability away from your main damage towers. **You can also use towers that are immune to stuns, such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]]. *When it first spawns, it is a [[Boss]] enemy, limiting the amount of towers that can slow it down. **As it has [[Stun Immunity]] by default, stunning towers cannot stun it regardless of if it is a boss or not, only slowing it down and it cannot be knocked back by towers with knockback. *One of the '''Fallen Honor Guard''' in [[Hidden Wave]] can regenerate its health, and spawn in hordes. **Towers that can stall hordes of enemies such as [[Cryomancer]] and [[Jester]] are required so that your towers can attack them for longer. ***Due to bugs, freezing towers can complete stop the '''Fallen Honor Guard''' from moving if it is frozen while performing its ''For Honor'' ability. **As it has [[Stun Immunity]], the [[Tesla]] is a much less effective option, however it can still be brought to deal with other enemies. **Due to multiple of them spawning, high DPS towers with [[Stun Immunity]] such as [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are heavily advised. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}}
